changes.new: UPDATE orders SET total_minor = CAST(ROUND(total_price * 100) AS BIGINT)

affected.fix: Update model to read customer.display_name or customer_id
Update SQL to use total_minor instead of total_price
Treat both PENDING and AWAITING_PAYMENT as not payable
Vendor v2 proto with deprecated alias

endpoints.why: Model fields total_price and customer_name have been removed, causing attribute errors during invoice building, and status PENDING was renamed, causing silent misinterpretation of unpaid orders.
References total_price which has been dropped from the order summary.
SQL revenue report queries total_price column which has been dropped in migration 0002.

impact.migration_notes: Orders v2 changes how an order's money, customer and payment state are represented. The REST payload, the gRPC OrderSummary message and the orders table all change in the same release. Readers of orders.total_price / orders.customer_name break due to schema removals and renames. Consumers should ship tolerant readers that accept v1 and v2 at the same time during rollout. Specifically, read total.amount_minor when present, else round(total_price * 100), and read customer.display_name when present, else customer_name. Treat both PENDING and AWAITING_PAYMENT as not payable.

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
+
+
+def _round_half_up(d: Decimal) -> int:
+    return int(d.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
+
+
+def normalize_status(value: str) -> str:
+    if value.startswith("ORDER_STATUS_"):
+        value = value[len("ORDER_STATUS_"):]
+    if value == "PENDING":
+        return "AWAITING_PAYMENT"
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OrderView:
+    order_id: str
+    customer_name: str
+    amount_minor: int
+    currency: str
+    status: str
+    created_at: str | None = None
+
+
+def from_rest(payload: dict) -> OrderView:
+    order_id = payload["order_id"]
+    status = normalize_status(payload["status"])
+    created_at = payload.get("created_at")
+
+    if "customer" in payload and isinstance(payload["customer"], dict):
+        customer_name = payload["customer"]["display_name"]
+    else:
+        customer_name = payload.get("customer_name", "")
+
+    if "total" in payload and isinstance(payload["total"], dict):
+        amount_minor = payload["total"]["amount_minor"]
+        currency = payload["total"]["currency"]
+    else:
+        tp = payload.get("total_price", 0)
+        amount_minor = _round_half_up(Decimal(str(tp)) * 100)
+        currency = "USD"
+
+    return OrderView(
+        order_id=order_id,
+        customer_name=customer_name,
+        amount_minor=amount_minor,
+        currency=currency,
+        status=status,
+        created_at=created_at,
+    )
+
+
+def from_summary(summary) -> OrderView:
+    order_id = summary.order_id
+    field = type(summary).DESCRIPTOR.fields_by_name["status"]
+    raw_status = field.enum_type.values_by_number[summary.status].name
+    status = normalize_status(raw_status)
+
+    if summary.HasField("total"):
+        amount_minor = summary.total.amount_minor
+        currency = summary.total.currency
+    else:
+        amount_minor = _round_half_up(Decimal(str(summary.total_price)) * 100)
+        currency = "USD"
+
+    if summary.HasField("customer"):
+        customer_name = summary.customer.display_name
+    else:
+        customer_name = summary.customer_name
+
+    return OrderView(
+        order_id=order_id,
+        customer_name=customer_name,
+        amount_minor=amount_minor,
+        currency=currency,
+        status=status,
+    )
